summary: Iteration 64 frontend-only verification of Verified Buyers acknowledgement gate + Source Transparency rewrite. All 9 scoped checks pass: modal appears in fresh sessions on /buyers, /buyers/:geid and /command-center; accept button disabled until checkbox ticked; modal closes on accept and does not reappear within same session across /buyers, /buyers/:geid and Command Center; Go back returns to Home. Source Transparency section has correct eyebrow, heading and description, exactly 7 category tiles with the required labels; none of the 15 forbidden individual organisation names appear in /buyers or in the buyer profile page (evidence chips + source warning). Legacy 'no contact arrangement' note, sanctions-screening line, 'Last updated' line and new legal USAGE_NOTE section (buyer-usage-note-section) are all present. Backend untouched: /api/buyers/sources still returns original organisation names, /api/buyers/search count = 22,515 unchanged. Regression: Home, /brain, /trade-news, /expo all load with only the pre-existing 401 (auth /me) console error — no new errors introduced. Mobile 390x844 and desktop 1920x800 render modal and 7-tile grid without horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: BuyerDataNotice initialises useState(true) then flips to false in useEffect if not ack'd — this hides the modal for a single paint on first load which is acceptable, but consider useState(() => sessionStorage.getItem(ACK_KEY) === '1') to avoid the flash and remove the need for the effect.

Gate uses sessionStorage (per-tab). If product intent is per-user-session across tabs, consider localStorage or a server-side ack flag. Current spec explicitly asks for sessionStorage so this is by-design.

CommandBuyers.jsx mounts <BuyerDataNotice /> inside cc-buyers, so if the module is not rendered (e.g. user not on the right CC tab) the gate won't block that view. Verified in this run that visiting /command-center fresh does still show the modal (likely from another page-level mount), but consider mounting the notice at CommandCenter page-level to be robust.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified Buyers acknowledgement gate + 7-tile Source Transparency rewrite is fully working on preview. sessionStorage key 'vametra_buyer_data_ack' controls the gate. Forbidden organisation strings verified absent on /buyers and buyer profile. Backend /api/buyers/sources intentionally still returns raw names (frontend maps via mapSourceName). No re-test needed.
